'''Porm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sedrian]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Sedri civil war]] he chose to side with the [[bishop of war]] [[Karak]] and his [[Karak's renegades|renegades]] in which he served as Karak's bodyguard. Porm accompanied Karak and five other renegades in an assault on the [[Sun caves]] in the city of [[Fitsay]] during the [[Battle of Fitsay|Siege of the Fitsay Sun Caves]] in an attempt to claim the power of the [[Golden Sun]]. He was killed in the ensuing fight.
